question: What sovereignty is claimed for Lalita-mother as great queen and sole leader of all circles?
premises: This verse names her with royal and leadership titles.
She is called Lalita-mother and great queen.
She is said to be sole leader of all circles.
inference: Lalita-mother is declared great queen and sole leader of all circles.
plain_english: Lalita-mother, the great queen, is the sole leader of all circles.
